query: UPDATE photos SET title=$2,description=$3,taken_at=coalesce(taken_at_override,$4),width=$5,height=$6,orientation=$7,is_hdr=$8,has_gain_map=$9,icc_name=$10,camera_make=$11,camera_model=$12,lens=$13,focal_mm=$14,aperture=$15,shutter=$16,iso=$17,gps_lat=CASE WHEN gps_overridden THEN gps_lat ELSE $18 END,gps_lon=CASE WHEN gps_overridden THEN gps_lon ELSE $19 END,place_id=$20,dominant_colors=$21,placeholder=$22 WHERE id=$1
